description: A wedding announcement of the Chabot/Bailey marriage; a clipping from the The New Mexican, 2-15-61, about the wedding; eighteen color photographs and one black and white photograph of the Chabot/Bailey wedding; a congratulatory letter from Bryce Hayter with notes and figures in pencil in the margin and on the back; a list of wedding gifts; and a mailing list of wedding announcements.
title: Wedding
